newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures set new high, then retreat.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures set new high, then retreat.

text.p: CME lumber futures advanced at the start and set a new contract high in May before slipping to mostly lower levels early.
May ran up to a new contract high of $417.50 per tbf on carryover demand sparked by a recent surge higher in cash lumber prices, traders said.
But futures then retreated as profit taking developed. Evening of positions ahead of Wednesday's housing starts report may also be weighing on prices, traders said.
At 0928 CDT, lumber stood $2.10 to $0.10 lower with May off $1.60 at $412.50 and July off most at $394.60 per tbf.
